title: JEPA-kMMVAE: CSI Prediction for Time-Varying Wireless Channels
abstract: arXiv:2610.13315v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper considers channel state information (CSI) prediction using neural networks for time-varying multi-antenna channels from noisy historical observations. The main challenge is to exploit temporal correlation while distinguishing channel evolution from observation noise. We propose JEPA-kMMVAE, which combines a joint-embedding predictive architecture with a k-memory Markov variational autoencoder to predict future CSI through temporally structured latent representations. The framework supports direct prediction and residual corrections relative to the latest latent state and noisy CSI observation. Simulation results show that the residual configuration outperforms the evaluated baselines at moderate and high input CSI signal-to-noise ratios, while sequence baselines remain more accurate under stronger noise.

translated_title: JEPA-kMMVAE：时变无线信道的信道状态信息预测
translated_abstract: 本文研究了利用神经网络从含噪历史观测中对时变多天线信道进行信道状态信息（CSI）预测的问题。主要挑战在于如何利用时间相关性，同时区分信道演化与观测噪声。我们提出了JEPA-kMMVAE，该方法将联合嵌入预测架构与k记忆马尔可夫变分自编码器相结合，通过具有时间结构的潜在表示来预测未来CSI。该框架支持直接预测以及相对于最新潜在状态和含噪CSI观测的残差校正两种模式。仿真结果表明，残差配置在中高输入CSI信噪比下优于所评估的基线方法，而在较强噪声环境下序列基线方法仍能保持更高的精度。
tldr: 提出JEPA-kMMVAE框架，将联合嵌入预测架构与k记忆马尔可夫变分自编码器结合，通过时间结构化的潜在表示从含噪观测中预测时变多天线信道的未来CSI，其中残差校正在中高信噪比下优于基线方法。
en_tdlr: Proposes JEPA-kMMVAE, which combines a joint-embedding predictive architecture with a k-memory Markov variational autoencoder to predict future CSI of time-varying multi-antenna channels through temporally structured latent representations, with the residual configuration outperforming baselines at moderate and high SNRs.
